en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a small market square in a historic European town. In the foreground is an octagonal fountain with a statue. Around the square are half-timbered and plastered houses with steep tiled roofs. At the center background stands an ornate gatehouse with a decorative gable, statues, and an arched passageway. Behind the town, rolling hills and fields form the landscape. Printed captions identify the scene as the market of Lauenstein in the Erzgebirge (Ore Mountains). A red handwritten number is in the upper right.
